entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I need to return a jersey I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Thank you. I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey. Before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. It turned out to be the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride last week and it's just way too tight across the shoulders.

I understand. Sizing can definitely be tricky. Let me just check the purchase date here... Okay, I see the delivery was about 70 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process that return for you.

That's great to hear. I was hoping to do an exchange, but I see the size I need is out of stock. Since I'll have to go through the trouble of repackaging and sending this back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

That's a reasonable request. Let me see... I do see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience of the item being out of stock, I can definitely do that. I will process the full refund for the jersey, and I've also just added a 20% discount coupon to your account, valid for your next purchase. How does that sound?
Oh, 20% is very generous. That's perfect, thank you so much, David. I really appreciate you doing that.

You're very welcome. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
